paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文是一篇关于声学窃听技术的综述，将目标论文归类为基于RFID的声学窃听方法，并简要描述了其通过墙窃听的能力和信号处理流程。

evidences.evidence_quote: [57] demonstrates the possibility of using low-cost and easily overlooked RFID tags to effectively perform through-the-wall eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: [57] demonstrates the possibility of using low-cost and easily overlooked RFID tags to effectively perform through-the-wall eavesdropping. A battery-free method called Tag-Bug is proposed. Tag-Bug extracts sound features in two ways: (i) vibration effect, in which the sound directly causes the label to vibrate; (ii) Reflection effect, in which the label does not vibrate, but perceives the reflected signal of nearby vibrating objects.

evidences.evidence_quote: Tag-Bug can effectively identify the number of human voices in free-space eavesdropping, thru-the-brick-wall eavesdropping, and thru-the-insulating-glass eavesdropping, as well as accurately identify letters in free-space eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: Experiments have shown that Tag-Bug can successfully capture monotonous sounds when the loudness is greater than 60 dB. Tag-Bug can effectively identify the number of human voices in free-space eavesdropping, thru-the-brick-wall eavesdropping, and thru-the-insulating-glass eavesdropping, as well as accurately identify letters in free-space eavesdropping.
